#===============================================================================
# First Use Item Replacement [v1.0] for RPG Maker VX Ace
# By ARIOSODEV
#===============================================================================
# USAGE RIGHTS & CREDITS
# You are not required by any means to provide credit for using my script(s)
# in your project. You are also free to edit and modify my scripts for any
# purpose.
#
# I would love to hear about your game though!!
#===============================================================================
# HOW TO USE?
# Firstly, you're going to want to create 2 versions of an item.
#   - Before First Use
#   - After First Use
#
# In the notes of the Before item, make sure to add this:
# <hidden item: A+B>
#
# Replace "A" with: ID of the Switch used to check for this item
# Replace "B" with: ID of the After item
#
# Once you've done that, you can now use this Script call:
# give_hidden_item(C, D)
#
# Replace "C" with: ID of the Before item
# Replace "D" with: Amount you want to give to the player.
#
# NOTE 1: If an Undiscovered item ID is not used, it will act like a normal
# "Change Items" event.
# NOTE 2: If you want to take away items from the player, simply make "D" a
# negative number.
#===============================================================================
# ADDITIONAL SUGGESTIONS
# I would personally recommend creating a Common Event tied to the Before
# items so that you can display a message for the player! I recommend these
# events:
#
#   > Show Text [ ... ]
#   > Script [ SceneManager.call(Scene_Item) ]
#
# You can add onto this if you wish!
#===============================================================================

#===============================================================================
# They told me to tell you not to edit the code past this point. So, uh...
#===============================================================================

class Game_Party < Game_Unit
  def consume_item(item)
    lose_item(item, 1) if item.is_a?(RPG::Item) && item.consumable
    if item.hidden_item != 0
      item_count = item_number(item)
      lose_item(item, item_count)
      gain_item($data_items[item.hidden_newitem], item_count)
      $game_switches[item.hidden_item] = true
      #Audio.se_stop
      #SceneManager.call(Scene_Item)
    end
  end
 
  def gain_hidden_item(item, amount, include_equip = false)
    $game_variables[2] = item
    $game_variables[3] = item.hidden_newitem
    if item.hidden_item != 0 && $game_switches[item.hidden_item]
      gain_item($data_items[item.hidden_newitem], amount)
    else
      container = item_container(item.class)
      return unless container
      last_number = item_number(item)
      new_number = last_number + amount
      container[item.id] = [[new_number, 0].max, max_item_number(item)].min
      container.delete(item.id) if container[item.id] == 0
      if include_equip && new_number < 0
        discard_members_equip(item, -new_number)
      end
      $game_map.need_refresh = true
    end
  end
end

class Game_Interpreter
 
  def give_hidden_item(item, amount)
    $game_party.gain_hidden_item($data_items[item], amount)
  end
end


module ARIOSODEV
  module HIDE
    HIDDEN_ITEM = /<hidden item:[ ]*(\d+)[+](\d+)>/i
  end
end

module DataManager
  class <<self; alias load_database_ari load_database; end
  def self.load_database
    load_database_ari
    load_notetags_ari
  end
 
  def self.load_notetags_ari
    groups = [$data_items]
    for group in groups
      for obj in group
        next if obj.nil?
        obj.load_notetags_ari
      end
    end
  end
end

class RPG::UsableItem < RPG::BaseItem
  attr_accessor :hidden_item
  attr_accessor :hidden_newitem
  def load_notetags_ari
    @hidden_item = 0
    @hidden_newitem = 0
    #---
    self.note.split(/[\r\n]+/).each { |line|
      case line
      #---
      when ARIOSODEV::HIDE::HIDDEN_ITEM
        @hidden_item = $1.to_i
        @hidden_newitem = $2.to_i
      end
    } # self.note.split
    #---
  end
end

module R2_HIDE_ITEM_DESC
  # text to show when not used
  DESC = "Unknown properties"
  # note tag for hidden description
  TAG = /<hidden desc>/i
end

# ╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║                      End of editable region                        ║
# ╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

#==============================================================================
# ■ DataManager
#==============================================================================

module DataManager
  class <<self; alias load_objects_itemdesc create_game_objects; end
  def self.create_game_objects
    load_objects_itemdesc
    load_notetags_itemdesc
  end
  def self.load_notetags_itemdesc
    for obj in $data_items
      next if obj.nil?
      obj.load_notetags_itemdesc
    end
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ■ RPG::Item
#==============================================================================

class RPG::Item
  def load_notetags_itemdesc
    @desc_hidden = false
    self.note.split(/[\r\n]+/).each { |line|
      case line
      when R2_HIDE_ITEM_DESC::TAG
        @desc_hidden = true
      end
    }
  end
  def desc_hidden
    @desc_hidden
  end
  def change_desc_hidden
    @desc_hidden = false
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ■ RPG::Weapon
#==============================================================================

class RPG::Weapon
  def desc_hidden
    false
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ■ RPG::Armor
#==============================================================================

class RPG::Armor
  def desc_hidden
    false
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Window_Help
#==============================================================================

class Window_Help
  def set_item(item)
    if item && item.desc_hidden
      set_text(R2_HIDE_ITEM_DESC::DESC)
    else
      set_text(item ? item.description : "")
    end
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Scene_ItemBase
#==============================================================================

class Scene_ItemBase
  alias :r2_use_item_desc_shown :use_item
  def use_item
    r2_use_item_desc_shown
    item.change_desc_hidden if item.desc_hidden == true
  end
end
